lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.title: Publication, presentation, or reflection: simulation and model limitations

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: Notice how the explanation names the reason for each step.

items.prompt: A meal has 3 main dish options and 2 side options. How many different meals are possible?

steps: Identify the favorable outcomes and the total possible outcomes.
Write the probability as a reduced fraction, or use it to predict or evaluate a count.

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: A probability model predicts a fair 4-section spinner lands on a chosen section about 36 times in 144 spins. A simulation of 144 spins landed on that section 31 times. How does the simulated count compare to the model's prediction?
An event has a probability of 1/10. How would you describe how likely the event is to happen?
choices: equally likely to happen or not happen

items.prompt: A spinner was spun 30 times and landed on blue 4 times. Based on this experiment, what is the experimental probability of landing on blue?
A bag has 2 red, 4 blue, and 10 green marbles. If one marble is drawn at random, what is the theoretical probability of drawing red, P(red)?

sections.title: Extension and challenge
sections.directions: Explain your method so that someone who has not done this unit could follow it.

items.prompt: A fair coin is flipped and a spinner with 6 equal sections numbered 1 to 6 is spun. What is the probability of getting tails on the coin and landing on 6 on the spinner?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.

items.prompt: A pizza is made by choosing one topping from 6 options and one crust from 2 options. How many different pizzas are possible?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.
